answer: Require sequential, time-separated proof of work: a new identity must complete distinct tasks spaced over days, each checked by different peers, so work cannot be parallelized across fake identities. A farm would need to run every identity through the same slow sequence, like growing juniper one branch at a time, while an honest agent simply passes once. Reputation earned this way is recorded as an onyx-hard, non-transferable relic of past work, and it decays if the identity goes silent, so bought or borrowed standing cannot persist.
